epics.title: Basic Stopwatch Controls
epics.description: Provide users with fundamental controls such as start, pause, and reset to measure time intervals easily. This feature is crucial for users to manage time accurately in different activities.

user_stories.title: Start Stopwatch
user_stories.story: As a user, I want to start the stopwatch so that I can begin measuring a time interval.
acceptance_criteria: The app provides a start button that initiates time measurement.
The start button changes state once the stopwatch is running.

user_stories.title: Pause Stopwatch
user_stories.story: As a user, I want to pause the stopwatch so that I can stop timing temporarily without resetting the current time.
acceptance_criteria: The app provides a pause button that stops the time measurement while keeping the elapsed time visible.

user_stories.title: Reset Stopwatch
user_stories.story: As a user, I want to reset the stopwatch so that I can clear the current time and start again.
acceptance_criteria: The app provides a reset button that sets the elapsed time back to zero.

epics.title: Display Elapsed Time
epics.description: Display the total time elapsed in real-time, so users can monitor the duration of their activity. This feature helps users keep track of their progress effectively.

user_stories.title: Show Elapsed Time
user_stories.story: As a user, I want to see the total time elapsed so that I can monitor the progress of my activity.
acceptance_criteria: The elapsed time is displayed prominently on the screen.
The displayed time updates in real-time as the stopwatch runs.

epics.title: Lap and Split Time Tracking
epics.description: Allow users to record lap and split times without interrupting the stopwatch. This feature enables users to track intermediate intervals during ongoing activities, such as laps in a race.

user_stories.title: Record Lap Times
user_stories.story: As a user, I want to record lap times so that I can track multiple intervals during an activity.
acceptance_criteria: The app provides a lap button that records the current elapsed time without stopping the stopwatch.
Lap times are displayed in a list for the user to review.

user_stories.title: Record Split Times
user_stories.story: As a user, I want to record split times so that I can measure specific segments within a larger timing session.
acceptance_criteria: The app provides a split button that records the current elapsed time.
Split times are shown along with timestamps for easy analysis.

epics.title: User-Friendly Interface
epics.description: Design a clean and intuitive interface to ensure users can easily operate the stopwatch. This is important to create an accessible and pleasant user experience.

user_stories.title: Simple and Clean Layout
user_stories.story: As a user, I want the interface to be simple and easy to understand so that I can operate the stopwatch without any confusion.
acceptance_criteria: The app has a minimal design with only necessary buttons (start, pause, reset, lap, split).
Buttons are clearly labeled and large enough for easy interaction.
